title: Top-Account Escalation Intake & Prioritization Framework
creator: Priya Nair
description: Goal: Create a repeatable intake and prioritization process for escalations and feature requests from top accounts that balances revenue impact, SLA risk, engineering effort, and systemic fixes. This ticket captures the intake form design, scoring matrix, triage routing rules, SLAs for responses, and the handoff process to engineering and Customer Success. Background: We have ad-hoc escalations from three strategic accounts in the last quarter that bypassed the normal roadmap process and consumed ~3 engineer-weeks each. That variance undermines predictability for Dedicated and Private rollout schedules. Scope: 1) Define a short intake form for AE/CS to submit (fields: account, ARR, severity, reproducibility, customer SLA, business impact, feature ask vs bug, desired timeline, escalation owner). 2) Design a weighted scoring matrix (account weight, severity, reproducibility, frequency, cost-of-delay). 3) Establish routing rules: immediate on-call escalation for Severity 1 SLO breaches; PM review for scores >= threshold; monthly prioritization bucket for scores in mid-range. 4) Draft a lightweight SLT for acknowledgements and commitment windows (24h ack for P0/P1 escalations, 7-day decision window for roadmap-level commitments). 5) Define engineering handoff checklist and success metrics (regression tests, post-deploy QA, customer validation steps). 6) Instrument dashboards to show intake volume, avg time-to-decision, and ARR at-risk. Out-of-scope: major product re-architecture proposals (these escalate to product strategy review). Deliverables: intake form, scoring spreadsheet, triage runbook, Confluence playbook, dashboard mocks, and an initial 8-week pilot with two top accounts.
acceptance_criteria: Intake form created and available in Confluence + short link in Hub
Scoring matrix defined with weights and example calculations for 8 historical escalations
Triage routing rules documented and testable in two simulated scenarios
SLT for acknowledgements published and signed off by CS and Sales leaders
Dashboard mockups for intake metrics reviewed by Data and Observability leads
Pilot plan with two accounts scheduled and CS owners assigned
